content:
alyssa: Heads-up: planning a staged base-image rebuild next week. Objectives: shrink attack surface (remove suid, unnecessary packages), rotate image signing key in KMS, tighten image-pusher RBAC, and wire audit logs to immutable storage for a 1yr retention. Also want vuln triage before we cut. Who picks up what?

priyanka: I can drive RBAC. Proposal: image-pusher role scoped to cluster service accounts, narrow GCR/GCS permissions, and separate signing grant to KMS signer principal. Prefer cluster-scoped SAs (dev/stage/prod) not per-repo. Thoughts? :white_check_mark:

jordan: I'll own KMS/signing rotation. Approach: create new key version, use cosign KMS URI for signing in CI, publish new public key to attestation service, and keep previous key version active for verification during rollback window. No downtime expected.

sam: I'll run vuln scans and produce a short triage. Plan: SBOM + trivy/clair, plus quick rebuild to Alpine 3.20.5 if CVE-2026-XY1 shows up. Will list any high-severity blockers.

ops-bot: [CI] image-rebuild/base #7012 started by alyssa
ops-bot: [CI] image-rebuild/base #7012 step: build -> PASS
ops-bot: [CI] image-rebuild/base #7012 step: sign -> FAIL (cosign: private key not available)

priyanka: That fail is expected until the new KMS key is granted to the runner. Jordan, can you provision an interim signing grant so canary can run?

jordan: Yes. Steps I'll run: 
1) gcloud kms keys versions create --key=img-signer --location=global --keyring=images
2) gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
3) update CI to use cosign with GCP KMS URI (no private key blobs)
4) cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/.../cryptoKeys/img-signer@<version> gcr.io/redwood/base:canary

sam: Scan command I'm using: `./tools/scan-image --image gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-05 --sbom --trivy --policy medium`
Preliminary: found libssl CVE-2026-0123 (medium), and an unnecessary package 'telnet' that should be removed.

priyanka: RBAC draft: create role 'roles/redwood.imagePusher' with minimal storage.objects.create/get/delete, gcr.upload, and no broad project-level perms. Separate IAM binding for kms.cryptoSign to a dedicated signer principal. I'll open infra PR with example bindings.

sec-eng-ken: Compliance notes: 
- KMS audit logs + GCR push logs need to be exported to a locked GCS bucket with retention 365d and object-level hold for immutability.
- Any cosign verification failure must trigger alert -> PagerDuty SEV2, with runbook referencing the image attestation play.
- Keep verification proof attached to the image metadata.

alyssa: Ken, can you draft the alert rule and runbook link? Priyanka, add bucket name/immutability policy to your PR. Jordan, do not expose private key material to CI. Use KMS URI.

ops-bot: [CI] image-rebuild/base #7015 started by priyanka
ops-bot: [CI] image-rebuild/base #7015 sign -> SUCCESS (cosign via KMS)

priyanka: Canary signed ok. Tagged gcr.io/redwood/base:canary-2026-03-06. Verified: `cosign verify --key https://attestation.redwood/pubkeys/img-signer.pem gcr.io/redwood/base:canary-2026-03-06` -> OK

jordan: Note for rollout: keep previous key verifiers in attestation service for 72h to support in-flight deploys. Also I'll add an automated key rotation play to the repo after this cut.

sam: Uploaded full SBOM and trivy output to the ticket. TL;DR: 1 medium (libssl CVE-2026-0123), no high. Recommendation: proceed with canary and schedule libssl patch in follow-up patch release. Removed telnet from the Dockerfile and pushed fix.

sec-eng-ken: Draft alert rule created in Splunk: 
- name: cosign_verification_failed
- query: index=imgsign "verification failed" | stats count
- condition: count > 0 for 1m
- severity: high (pagerduty-image-sigs)
Runbook attached: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/image-attest-failure

alyssa: Action items: 
- priyanka: PR for RBAC + bucket immutability (ETA EOD)
- jordan: provision key versions + update CI to use KMS URI (ETA tomorrow AM)
- sam: finalize scan + mitigation list (ETA tomorrow noon)
- ken: finalize alert + runbook (ETA tomorrow)
Scheduling 30m sync Monday 09:30 to validate canary metrics (pull latency, verify latency, image-pull error rate).

jordan: Also opened a networking change to allow higher registry egress bursts during canary window.

priyanka: PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pulls/312 - includes role, example binding templates, and GCS bucket policy for immutability. Please review. :sparkles:

ops-bot: [CI] image-rebuild/base #7015 promoted to canary-rollout by priyanka

alyssa: If canary shows no issues we'll proceed with staged rollout. If cosign verification failures or new high CVEs appear, abort and revert. Thanks team. :clap:

priyanka: ACK. I'll watch the PR and coordinate approvals.

sec-eng-ken: I'll publish the PagerDuty rotation and finalize the playbook.

jordan: Keys staged and permissions applied to CI principal. Public key uploaded to attestation endpoint.

alyssa: Closing the thread; follow-up sync scheduled Monday.
